# IntervalField { #timetoalign.IntervalField }

```python
IntervalField(raw=None, unit=None, number_type=None, *, source_fields=None)
```

Semantic field storing intervals with shared axis metadata.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name          | Type                                                                        | Description                                                       | Default   |
|---------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| raw           | [StructField](`timetoalign.core.fields.StructField`) \| None                | Struct field containing ``start`` and ``end`` coordinate structs. | `None`    |
| unit          | [TimeUnit](`timetoalign.core.enums.TimeUnit`) \| [str](`str`) \| None       | Common endpoint unit.                                             | `None`    |
| number_type   | [NumberType](`timetoalign.core.enums.NumberType`) \| [str](`str`) \| None   | Common endpoint number type.                                      | `None`    |
| source_fields | [str](`str`) \| [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\] \| None | Optional blueprint source-field declaration.                      | `None`    |

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [domain](#timetoalign.IntervalField.domain) | Return the temporal domain implied by the unit. |
| [duration](#timetoalign.IntervalField.duration) | Return the vectorized duration field. |
| [end](#timetoalign.IntervalField.end) | Return the vectorized end-coordinate field. |
| [number_type](#timetoalign.IntervalField.number_type) | Return the common endpoint number type. |
| [semantic_type](#timetoalign.IntervalField.semantic_type) | Return the paired scalar semantic type. |
| [start](#timetoalign.IntervalField.start) | Return the vectorized start-coordinate field. |
| [unit](#timetoalign.IntervalField.unit) | Return the common endpoint unit. |

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [from_field](#timetoalign.IntervalField.from_field) | Build an interval field from an Arrow or raw field source. |
| [from_intervals](#timetoalign.IntervalField.from_intervals) | Build an interval field from scalar intervals. |
| [metadata_dict](#timetoalign.IntervalField.metadata_dict) | Return semantic type and shared axis metadata. |

### from_field { #timetoalign.IntervalField.from_field }

```python
IntervalField.from_field(
    source,
    *,
    unit=None,
    number_type=None,
    name='interval',
)
```

Build an interval field from an Arrow or raw field source.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | Description                           | Default      |
|-------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------|--------------|
| source      | [pa](`pyarrow`).[Array](`pyarrow.Array`) \| [pa](`pyarrow`).[ChunkedArray](`pyarrow.ChunkedArray`) \| [StructField](`timetoalign.core.fields.StructField`) \| [pa](`pyarrow`).[Field](`pyarrow.Field`) \| [tuple](`tuple`)\[[pa](`pyarrow`).[Array](`pyarrow.Array`) \| None, [pa](`pyarrow`).[Field](`pyarrow.Field`)\] | Supported Arrow field representation. | _required_   |
| unit        | [TimeUnit](`timetoalign.core.enums.TimeUnit`) \| [str](`str`) \| None                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | Common endpoint unit override.        | `None`       |
| number_type | [NumberType](`timetoalign.core.enums.NumberType`) \| [str](`str`) \| None                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | Common endpoint number type override. | `None`       |
| name        | [str](`str`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | Field name for a bare array.          | `'interval'` |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                   | Description                         |
|--------|--------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------|
|        | [IntervalField](`timetoalign.core.time.IntervalField`) | A live or blueprint interval field. |

### from_intervals { #timetoalign.IntervalField.from_intervals }

```python
IntervalField.from_intervals(
    intervals,
    *,
    unit=None,
    number_type=None,
    name='interval',
)
```

Build an interval field from scalar intervals.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type                                                                                           | Description                                                        | Default      |
|-------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------|
| intervals   | [Sequence](`collections.abc.Sequence`)\[[Interval](`timetoalign.core.time.Interval`) \| None\] | Interval values, optionally containing null rows.                  | _required_   |
| unit        | [TimeUnit](`timetoalign.core.enums.TimeUnit`) \| [str](`str`) \| None                          | Shared unit override, required for an empty/all-null input.        | `None`       |
| number_type | [NumberType](`timetoalign.core.enums.NumberType`) \| [str](`str`) \| None                      | Shared number type override, required for an empty/all-null input. | `None`       |
| name        | [str](`str`)                                                                                   | Arrow field name.                                                  | `'interval'` |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                   | Description            |
|--------|--------------------------------------------------------|------------------------|
|        | [IntervalField](`timetoalign.core.time.IntervalField`) | A live interval field. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                             |
|--------|----------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If non-null intervals do not share one metadata triple. |

### metadata_dict { #timetoalign.IntervalField.metadata_dict }

```python
IntervalField.metadata_dict()
```

Return semantic type and shared axis metadata.
